acceptance: The triggering event types and the failing code path are identified, with run ids.
On a new PR, `gate / gate` either passes or is skipped neutrally for these events, and never fails while review is pending.
A stale failure no longer leaves a PR BLOCKED once a later run succeeds.
context:
Triage 2026-11-07 (read-only, with run ids; the full report is in the session).
- Partly valid.
- `gate / gate` fails on 92% of pull_request_target runs: 267 of 290 since 11-01. 102 PRs were affected, and 72 of 96 merged PRs ended red. Re-locks didn't change this.
- The failure is NOT "cannot resolve a pull request number". That text appears only in the echoed script of the "Resolve the pull request" step, which never failed. That path is unreachable: gate.yml:138-141 skips push, schedule and workflow_run.
- The real cause: gate.py:385-389 exits 3 ("posted, waiting") for every non-pass verdict, and Theseus gate.yml:236 doesn't accept exit 3. The sweep job does accept it (gate.yml:357), and docs/hosted-workflows.md:90 defines 3 as waiting.
- The #4007 BLOCKED claim is false. The cause was an unresolved review thread (required_review_thread_resolution); the PR went CLEAN about 1 minute after the thread was resolved. No ruleset or BenchBox tool reads the `gate / gate` check-run.
- Severity: noise. It hides the rare real gate error: 3 of 381 failures were exit 2, e.g. 41640051806 (HTTP 500).
- Fix in Theseus gate.yml:222-236: treat exit 3 as success/neutral for the job, and keep exit 2 as failure. Then re-lock BenchBox.
- Acceptance criteria 1 and 3 rest on false premises. Dispatch refresh runs attach their check to the develop SHA, so "a later success supersedes" can't apply.
- Little overlap with oracle-gate-bridge-noop-runs-hold-runner-slots-20261101, but its concurrency guardrails apply to any job-level change.
- Recommended priority: low. Fold the fix into Theseus v0.2.4.
description:
From 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-07, the `gate / gate` check (review-gate bridge) failed on #3949, #3952, #3960, #3979, #3991, #3992, #3994, #3995 and #4007. The log says 'cannot resolve a pull request number'; on some PRs it fails within 14-17 s with 'review: waiting' before the verdict posts. It is not a required check, so arming and merging go ahead, but it leaves a red check on the PR. On #4007 a stale failed run (42342923424) kept the PR BLOCKED until its failed jobs were rerun. Agents and reviewers cannot tell a real gate failure from this noise.

Change. Find why the bridge cannot resolve the PR number for these events (event type, fork or merge-queue refs, timing before the PR exists). Make it resolve the number or skip neutrally, and make a later success supersede the stale failure. Related: oracle-gate-bridge-noop-runs-hold-runner-slots-20261101 and the Theseus adoption items.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create); never edit the primary clone; heavy work only through make heavy-run; container checks under mocker one stack at a time (limits in tests/uat docs and the uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106 context); no live cloud without owner approval; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing.
